<h2 class="page-break" id="timer-functions">Timer Functions</h2>
<h3 id="sys_t">sys_T</h3>
<p>Returns the current value of the rolling 32bit system timer (1mse) LO word.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_T();</code></p>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  The value of system timer. (LO Word)</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-293-1" name="__codelineno-293-1" href="#__codelineno-293-1"></a><span class="nl">t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sys_T</span><span class="p">();</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="sys_t_hi">sys_T_HI</h3>
<p>Returns the current value of the rolling 32bit system timer (1mse) HI word.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_T_HI();</code></p>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  The value of system timer. (HI Word)</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-294-1" name="__codelineno-294-1" href="#__codelineno-294-1"></a><span class="nl">t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sys_T_HI</span><span class="p">();</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="sys_settimer">sys_SetTimer</h3>
<p>Set a countdown on the selected timer or 'top-up' if required. There are 8 timers <strong>TIMER0</strong> to <strong>TIMER7</strong> which stop at the count of 0. Maximum timeout period is 65, 535 milliseconds or 65.535 seconds. A timer can be read with the <a href="#sys_gettimer">sys_GetTimer()</a> function.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_SetTimer(timernum, value);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">timernum</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">One of eight timers <strong>TIMER0</strong> to <strong>TIMER7</strong>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">value</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Countdown period in milliseconds.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  None</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-295-1" name="__codelineno-295-1" href="#__codelineno-295-1"></a><span class="n">sys_SetTimer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">TIMER5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3600</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">//Set Timer5 for 3.6 seconds.</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="sys_gettimer">sys_GetTimer</h3>
<p>Returns 0 if timer has expired, or the current countdown value. There are 8 timers <strong>TIMER0</strong> to <strong>TIMER7</strong> which stop at the count of 0. Maximum timeout period is 65, 535 milliseconds or 65.535 seconds.</p>
<p>A timer can be set with the <a href="#sys_settimer">sys_SetTimer()</a> function.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_GetTimer(timernum);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">timernum</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">One of eight timers <strong>TIMER0</strong> to <strong>TIMER7</strong>.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  0 if timer has expired, or the current countdown value.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-296-1" name="__codelineno-296-1" href="#__codelineno-296-1"></a><span class="nl">t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sys_GetTimer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">TIMER2</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="sys_settimerevent">sys_SetTimerEvent</h3>
<p>Set a function to be called for selected timer. When the timer reaches zero, the function is called. The called function must not have any parameters, and should not have a return value. This is necessary because the timer event is invoked asynchronously to the mainline program (i.e, it is not called in the normal way, so parameters and return values don’t apply).</p>
<p><a href="#sys_settimerevent">sys_SetTimerEvent(timernum, 0)</a> disables the timer event.</p>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
<p>When a child process is run using the <a href="#file_run">file_run</a> or <a href="#file_exec">file_exec</a> function, or if a file was loaded with <a href="#file_loadfunction">file_Loadfunction</a> and is executed, the loaded process gets its own code and memory space, therefore, any timer that reaches zero that has a timer event attached in the parent code space, will fail and cause a crash as an attempt is made to force the program counter to some wild place in the child process - There are 2 ways to overcome this problem.</p>
<ol>
<li>If a child process will not be requiring the use of any timers or timer events, the parent program can simply use the <a href="#sys_eventspostpone">sys_EventsPostpone()</a> function before calling or entering the child process. Once the parent program regains control, the <a href="#sys_eventresume">sys_EventResume()</a> function will allow any events in the queue to then be processed. The side effect of this method is that several events may bank up, and will execute immediately once the <a href="#sys_eventresume">sys_EventResume()</a> takes place. This however disallows a child process to use any timer events in the sub program so method 2 is preferable in this case.</li>
<li>The parent program can 'disconnect' the event(s) by setting it/them to zero prior to child process execution, or setting the associated timer to zero so the event wont fire. In either case, it is necessary to do the following: <code>while(sys_EventQueue());</code></li>
</ol>
<p>To ensure the event queue is empty prior to calling the child process. Note also that if just the timer is set to zero, the child process cannot use this timer. If the timer was now set to a value and the old event still existed, when the timer reaches zero the 'bad' parent address event will fire causing a crash.</p>
<p>The reverse situation also applies of course, the same level of respect is required if a child program needs to use any timer events. Method [1] (above) will not work as the events have been postponed, stopping the child process from using any timer events. If the child process did an <a href="#sys_eventresume">sys_EventResume()</a> in this case, everything would crash miserably. So the same applies, a child that uses any timer events must respect any timers that may be used by the parent, and a child must zero the <strong>sys_SetTimerEvent</strong> before returning to the parent.</p>
<p><code>sys_SetTimerEvent(timernum, 0)</code> disables the timer event.</p>
</div>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_SetTimerEvent(timernum, function);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">timernum</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">One of eight timers <strong>TIMER0</strong> to <strong>TIMER7</strong>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">function</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Event Function to be queued.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  Any previous event function address, or zero if there was no previous function.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-297-1" name="__codelineno-297-1" href="#__codelineno-297-1"></a><span class="n">sys_SetTimerEvent</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">TIMER5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">myfunc</span><span class="p">);</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="sys_eventqueue">sys_EventQueue</h3>
<p>Returns the max number of events that were pending in the event queue since the last call to this function. This can be used to assess event overhead burden, especially after or during a <a href="#sys_eventspostpone">sys_EventsPostpone</a> action.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_EventQueue();</code></p>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  Number of events.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-298-1" name="__codelineno-298-1" href="#__codelineno-298-1"></a><span class="nl">tasks</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">sys_EventQueue</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">//</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="sys_eventspostpone">sys_EventsPostpone</h3>
<p>Postpone any events until the <a href="#sys_eventsresume">sys_EventResume</a> function is executed. The event queue will continue to queue events, but no action will take place until a <a href="#sys_eventsresume">sys_EventResume</a> function is encountered.</p>
<p>The queue will continue to receive up to 32 events before discarding any further events. This function is required to allow a sequence of instructions or functions to occur that would otherwise be corrupted by an event occurring during the sequence of instructions or functions. </p>
<p>A good example of this is when you set a position to print, if there was no way of locking the current sequence, an event may occur which does a similar thing, and a contention would occur - printing to the wrong position. This function should be used wisely, if any action that is required would take considerable time, it is better to disable any conflicting event functions with a bypass flag, then restart the conflicting event by re-issuing a timer value.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_EventsPostpone();</code></p>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  None</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-299-1" name="__codelineno-299-1" href="#__codelineno-299-1"></a><span class="n">sys_EventsPostpone</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// postpone the event queue</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="sys_eventsresume">sys_EventsResume</h3>
<p>Resume any postponed events. The queue will try to execute any events that were incurred during the postponed period. Note that queued events are only checked for and executed at the end of each 4DGL instruction.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_EventsResume();</code></p>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  None</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-300-1" name="__codelineno-300-1" href="#__codelineno-300-1"></a><span class="n">sys_EventsResume</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// resume the event queue</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="sys_deepsleep">sys_DeepSleep</h3>
<p>Deep Sleep is a sleep state that is ‘deeper’ than the regular Sleep (for most display modules) and therefore consumes less power. Some displays do not support being powered to a lower state, so sleep and deepsleep power consumption can sometimes be roughly the same.</p>
<p>Puts the display and processor into the lowest power mode for a period of time. If "<strong>units</strong>" is zero, the display goes into sleep mode forever and needs power cycling to re-initialize. If "<strong>units</strong>" is 1 to 65535, the display will sleep for that period of time, or will be woken when touch screen is touched. The function returns the count of "<strong>units</strong>" that are remaining when the screen was touched. When returning from deep sleep mode, some displays might lose their screen and/or need to be reinitialised with <a href="#disp_init">disp_Init()</a>.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_DeepSleep(units);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">units</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Sleep timer units are approx 1 second. When in sleep mode, timing is controlled by an RC oscillator, therefore, timing is not totally accurate and should not be relied on for timing purposes.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  Remaining time units when touch screen is touched, else returns zero.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-301-1" name="__codelineno-301-1" href="#__codelineno-301-1"></a><span class="n">sys_DeepSleep</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// Sleep for 1 minute</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="sys_sleep">sys_Sleep</h3>
<p>Regular sleep, which puts the display and processor into low power mode for a period of time. If "<strong>units</strong>" is zero, the display goes into sleep mode forever and needs power cycling to re-initialize. If "<strong>units</strong>" is 1 to 65535, the display will sleep for that period of time, or will be woken when touch screen is touched. The function returns the count of "<strong>units</strong>" that are remaining when the screen was touched. When returning from sleep mode, the display and processor are restored from low power mode.</p>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
<p><a href="#sys_sleep">sys_Sleep()</a> was found to have an issue in PmmC’s prior to R33, the units value was not always near 1 second. This has been corrected in PmmC R33.</p>
</div>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>sys_Sleep(units);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">units</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Sleep timer units are approx 1 second. When in sleep mode, timing is controlled by an RC oscillator, therefore, timing is not totally accurate and should not be relied on for timing purposes.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  Remaining time units when touch screen is touched, else returns zero.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-302-1" name="__codelineno-302-1" href="#__codelineno-302-1"></a><span class="n">sys_Sleep</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// Sleep for 1 minute</span>
</code></pre></div>

<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>touch_DetectRegion(x1, y1, x2, y2);</code></p>

<h3 class="page-break" id="touch_set">touch_Set</h3>
<p>Sets various Sets various Touch Screen related parameters.</p>

<p><code>touch_Set(TOUCH_ENABLE);</code> - Enables and initialises Touch Screen hardware</p>
<p><strong>mode = TOUCH_DISABLE (Mode 1)</strong> Disable Touch Screen.</p>
<p><code>touch_Set(TOUCH_DISABLE);</code> - Disables the Touch Screen.</p>
<p><strong>mode = TOUCH_REGIONDEFAULT (Mode 2)</strong> Default Touch Region.</p>
<p><code>touch_Set(TOUCH_REGIONDEFAULT);</code> - This will reset the current active region to default which is the full screen area</p>
<div class="admonition note">

<h3 class="page-break" id="touch_get">touch_Get</h3>
<p>Returns various Touch Screen parameters to caller.</p>
<p>Sometimes NOTOUCH can be returned when the touchscreen is touched and held (in between pressed and released). This occurs if the touch points are identical on two successive calls, because it does not qualify as MOVING, but it has not yet been RELEASED (but has already been PRESSED)</p>
<p><strong>mode = TOUCH_STATUS (Mode 0)</strong> - Returns the various states of the touch screen</p>
<ul>
<li>0 = INVALID/NOTOUCH</li>
<li>1 = TOUCH_PRESSED</li>
<li>2 = TOUCH_RELEASED</li>
<li>3 = TOUCH_MOVING</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>mode = TOUCH_GETX (Mode 1)</strong> - Returns the X coordinates of the touch reported by mode 0</p>
<p><strong>mode = TOUCH_GETY (Mode 2)</strong> - Returns the Y coordinates of the touch reported by mode 0</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>touch_Get(mode);</code></p>

</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>

<h2 class="page-break" id="widget-functions">Widget Functions</h2>
<h3 id="widget_create">widget_Create</h3>
<p>Creates a widget control capable of holding count elements and returns a handle for the control.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Create(count);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">count</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">The number of elements in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  Widget control handle.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><a id="__codelineno-307-1" name="__codelineno-307-1" href="#__codelineno-307-1"></a><span class="n">var</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">;</span>
<a id="__codelineno-307-2" name="__codelineno-307-2" href="#__codelineno-307-2"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">);</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="widget_add">widget_Add</h3>
<p>Add a widget ram entry "<strong>widget</strong>" into index "<strong>index</strong>" of the widget control referenced by "<strong>hndl</strong>".</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Add(hndl, index, widget);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">widget</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Pointer to RAM allocation of the entry widget.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  None</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-308-1" name="__codelineno-308-1" href="#__codelineno-308-1"></a><span class="n">var</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">;</span>
<a id="__codelineno-308-2" name="__codelineno-308-2" href="#__codelineno-308-2"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-308-3" name="__codelineno-308-3" href="#__codelineno-308-3"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed1RAM</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// Add entry index 0 for Led</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_delete">widget_Delete</h3>
<p>Delete widget ram entry "<strong>index</strong>" from the widget control referenced by "<strong>hndl</strong>".</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Delete(hndl, index);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>

</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  </p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-309-1" name="__codelineno-309-1" href="#__codelineno-309-1"></a><span class="n">var</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">;</span>

<a id="__codelineno-309-3" name="__codelineno-309-3" href="#__codelineno-309-3"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed1RAM</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="c1">// Add entry index 0 for Led1</span>

<h3 id="widget_realloc">widget_Realloc</h3>
<p>Resizes a widget control "<strong>handle</strong>" to contain <strong>n</strong> entries, allowing it to be expanded or condensed. Doing this unnecessarily can lead to RAM fragmentation. It is much better to allocate widget controls once with the desired number of entries.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Realloc(handle, n);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">handle</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">n</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">New number of entries.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  New handle to widget control.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-310-1" name="__codelineno-310-1" href="#__codelineno-310-1"></a><span class="n">var</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">;</span>
<a id="__codelineno-310-2" name="__codelineno-310-2" href="#__codelineno-310-2"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-310-3" name="__codelineno-310-3" href="#__codelineno-310-3"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed1RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-310-4" name="__codelineno-310-4" href="#__codelineno-310-4"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed2RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-310-5" name="__codelineno-310-5" href="#__codelineno-310-5"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed3RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-310-6" name="__codelineno-310-6" href="#__codelineno-310-6"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Realloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="c1">// Reallocate widget control</span>
</code></pre></div>
<h3 id="widget_loadflash">widget_LoadFlash</h3>

</tr>

</table></div></div>

<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>

</code></pre></div>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_getword">widget_GetWord</h3>
<p>Returns specified word (0-14) from a widget entry. Refer to widget control entry offsets. This function requires that a widget control has been created with the <a href="#widget_create">widget_Create()</a> function.</p>

</tr>

</tbody>
</table></div></div>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_disable">widget_Disable</h3>
<p>Disable an item in a widget control. This function requires that a widget control has been created with the <a href="#widget_create">widget_Create()</a> function.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Disable(hndl, index);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  True if index was ok and function was successful.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong>: See example in <a href="#widget_enable">widget_Enable()</a>.</p>
<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_setattributes">widget_SetAttributes</h3>
<p>This function SETS one or more bits in the widget flags field of a widget control entry. "<strong>value</strong>" refers to various bits in the widget control entry (see widget attribute flags). A '1' bit in the "value" field SETS the respective bit in the widget flags field of the widget control entry.</p>
<p>Widget attribute flags to be used and maintained by widgets and touch processing:</p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x8000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to disable touch for this image, <br>(default=1 for movie, 0 for image).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INTERNAL</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x4000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Internal use only (force redraw on next write).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INITIALISED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x2000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Flag when ‘base gauge needle, etc.’ is done</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x1000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to prevent draw of new needle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INPUT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0800</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_FLASH</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0400</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">set if this is a flash based widget.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_RESERVED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x03c0</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">bits 9-6 reserved.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_SetAttributes(hndl, index, value);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">value</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">The word to be written to the entry.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  TRUE if successful, return value usually ignored.</p>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_clearattributes">widget_ClearAttributes</h3>
<p>This function CLEARS one or more bits in the widget flags field of an image control entry. "value" refers to various bits in the widget control entry (see widget attribute flags). A '1' bit in the "value" field CLEARS the respective bit in the widget flags field of the image control entry.</p>
<p>Widget attribute flags to be used and maintained by widgets and touch processing:</p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x8000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to disable touch for this image, <br>(default=1 for movie, 0 for image).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INTERNAL</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x4000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Internal use only (force redraw on next write).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INITIALISED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x2000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Flag when ‘base gauge needle, etc.’ is done</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x1000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to prevent draw of new needle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INPUT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0800</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_FLASH</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0400</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">set if this is a flash based widget.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_RESERVED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x03c0</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">bits 9-6 reserved.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_ClearAttributes(hndl, index, value);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">value</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">The word to be written to the entry.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  TRUE if successful, return value usually ignored.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_touched">widget_Touched</h3>
<p>This function requires that a widget control has been created with the <a href="#widget_create">widget_Create()</a> function.</p>
<p>Returns index of the widget touched or returns -1 if no widget was touched.</p>
<p>If index is passed as <strong>-1</strong> or <strong>ALL</strong> the function tests all widgets.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Touched(hndl, index);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  -1 if image not touched, or returns index.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-319-1" name="__codelineno-319-1" href="#__codelineno-319-1"></a><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">==</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">TOUCH_PRESSED</span><span class="p">)</span>
<a id="__codelineno-319-2" name="__codelineno-319-2" href="#__codelineno-319-2"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="nl">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Touched</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ALL</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="c1">//scan widget list, looking for a touch</span>
<a id="__codelineno-319-3" name="__codelineno-319-3" href="#__codelineno-319-3"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<a id="__codelineno-319-4" name="__codelineno-319-4" href="#__codelineno-319-4"></a><span class="w">        </span><span class="n">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="c1">// print index of widget touched</span>
<a id="__codelineno-319-5" name="__codelineno-319-5" href="#__codelineno-319-5"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="n">endif</span>
<a id="__codelineno-319-6" name="__codelineno-319-6" href="#__codelineno-319-6"></a><span class="n">endif</span>
</code></pre></div>
